sections.title: Creating New Ventures with Emerging Technologies
sections.description: Given the rapid pace of change in emerging technologies and the opportunity to create new businesses and even disrupt existing markets, there is a need for students to have a good understanding of these emerging technologies and how to apply them to create new ventures that drive sustainable value. This course explores key emerging technology areas, such as AI / GenAI, Machine Learning, Quantum Computing, Robotics, and Security/Privacy aspects of these technologies and provides frameworks and examples for creating new applications and ventures based on these technologies. Topics include: a review of emerging technology areas including the landscape and key trends; frameworks for identifying key challenges and new opportunity areas; steps for evaluating, developing, validating, and launching new ventures based on emerging technologies; and instruction on how to create and deliver compelling business plans and venture pitches. Students get to apply knowledge from the course in a group or individual project focused on designing a potential application and pitching a venture that would leverage one of the emerging technologies covered in the course. Students will also benefit from real world accomplished technology and business practitioners through guest lectures and demonstrations. Final group or individual projects will also benefit from judging and feedback from senior industry executives and tech investors to provide feedback on their venture’s commercial viability.
